earth.name: Earth Observation CubeSat
earth.objective: Monitor wildfires, floods, and climate from orbit

objectives.name: Wildfire monitoring
objectives.description: Detect active wildfires and burn scars using thermal + optical imaging.

objectives.name: Flood monitoring
objectives.description: Map flood extent using radar that sees through clouds.

objectives.name: Climate tracking
objectives.description: Track atmospheric CO2 and temperature trends over time.

earth.description: A low-cost CubeSat in Low Earth Orbit that images Earth to help emergency responders and climate scientists. A great first mission.
earth.why: LEO is close to Earth, so you get high-resolution images and cheap launches — ideal for beginners.

telescope.name: Space Telescope
telescope.objective: Observe the universe in a chosen wavelength

objectives.name: Optical astronomy
objectives.description: Visible-light imaging of stars and galaxies (like Hubble).

objectives.name: Infrared astronomy
objectives.description: See through dust clouds and observe cool objects (like JWST).

objectives.name: Ultraviolet astronomy
objectives.description: Study hot young stars and active galaxies.

objectives.name: X-ray astronomy
objectives.description: Observe black holes and supernova remnants (like Chandra).

telescope.description: A space telescope that must stay pointed at distant stars for years. Wavelength choice drives instrument, cooling, and orbit decisions.
telescope.why: Telescopes need stable pointing, thermal control, and the right detectors for their wavelength. More complex than a CubeSat.

lunar.name: Lunar Orbiter / Lander
lunar.objective: Map the Moon and scout landing sites

objectives.name: Lunar mapping
objectives.description: Map the lunar surface for future landing sites and resources.

objectives.name: Magnetic field
objectives.description: Measure the Moon's weak magnetic field with a magnetometer.

objectives.name: Water ice detection
objectives.description: Search for water ice in permanently shadowed craters.

lunar.description: Go to the Moon. You need more delta-v, a lunar-capable launcher, and survival through two-week lunar nights.
lunar.why: The Moon is far: more radiation, longer eclipses, and you need a bigger rocket than LEO.

mars.name: Mars Orbiter
mars.objective: Study Mars atmosphere, surface, and relay surface data

objectives.name: Surface mapping
objectives.description: High-resolution imaging of the Martian surface.

objectives.name: Data relay
objectives.description: Relay data from Mars surface rovers back to Earth.

mars.description: An advanced interplanetary mission. Long cruise, high radiation, and an Earth-Mars link with minutes of delay.
mars.why: Mars is the hardest destination: enormous delta-v, long delays, and you must design for years of autonomy.

sandbox.name: Sandbox

objectives.name: Free choice
objectives.description: Design any mission you like with no budget cap.

sandbox.description: Unlimited budget, no objective, no constraints. Experiment freely to learn how the systems interact.
sandbox.why: No goals means no wrong answers — good for learning and tinkering.
